classical_node_summary.key_notes: Reln is the sole defining marker; this is the adult-persisting glutamatergic subpopulation (reelin+/calretinin+/VGluT3+). UBERON:0005403 has an incorrect cross-reference to MBA:493 (Striatum ventral region) — location scoring based on striatum is invalid. True soma locations are hippocampal: CA1 SLM and DG OML. No negative markers defined.

location_warning: UBERON:0005403 (hippocampus stratum lacunosum-moleculare) mapped to MBA:493 (Striatum ventral region) — a known incorrect cross-reference. Any DB location score based on this mapping is invalid. Candidates must be assessed against CA1 SLM (MBA:391) and DG molecular layer (MBA:10703) directly.

0.name: 0497 HPF CR Glut_1
0.rationale: The label 'HPF CR' (hippocampal formation Cajal-Retzius) directly names this cell class. Soma distribution is precisely hippocampal: Dentate gyrus molecular layer (640 cells; DG OML) and Field CA1 stratum lacunosum-moleculare (139 cells) — matching both soma locations of hpc_cajal_retzius_cell exactly. Reln mean expression is 12.4 (highest of all hippocampal clusters by a wide margin; next highest is 4.9 in CLUS_0504). Defining markers include Trp73 (p73, canonical CR cell TF), Shisal2b, Creb5, Gdf5; MERFISH markers include Emx2, Ndnf, Eya2, Zic1, Gfra1 — all consistent with the CR cell transcriptomic signature. Calb2 (calretinin) mean expression 4.9, consistent with the calretinin+ subpopulation described classically. No neuropeptides recorded. No classical negative markers violated. This is the primary hippocampal CR cell cluster with correctly mapped anatomy and strongly elevated Reln.

0.name: 0500 HPF CR Glut_1
0.rationale: Also labeled 'HPF CR' with highest Reln mean expression (12.5) and high Calb2 (8.2) among the three HPF CR clusters. However, anatomy is entirely olfactory/amygdalar: Piriform area (8 cells), DG molecular layer (6 cells), Cortical amygdalar area (12 cells), Entorhinal area L1 (5 cells). The classical node soma is restricted to hippocampal SLM and DG OML; this cluster's soma distribution is predominantly in olfactory cortex and amygdala with minimal hippocampal representation. Despite the strong Reln and Calb2 expression, the location mismatch disqualifies this as a good match for the hippocampal CR cell. It represents a related CR-like population in olfactory cortex. Caveat: if the atlas captures a pan-cortical CR supertype, this could be a distant relative rather than the hippocampal type.

0.name: 0499 HPF CR Glut_1
0.rationale: Labeled 'HPF CR' with high Reln mean expression (11.9). Defining markers: Dsp, Plcz1, Eomes; TF markers include Eomes (Tbr2), Trp73, Bhlhe22. Eomes/Tbr2 is typically associated with immature granule cells or intermediate progenitors, not mature CR cells. Calb2 is very low (0.6), inconsistent with the calretinin+ classical CR cell signature. Anatomy is entirely olfactory bulb and olfactory cortex (no hippocampal cells). Neuropeptides: Npb and Adcyap1 at low levels — no classical match expected. This cluster appears to represent a CR-related population in the olfactory system with a distinct molecular identity from the hippocampal type.

0.name: 0503 DG Glut_1
0.rationale: Soma in DG molecular layer (424) and polymorph layer (466), with additional cells in CA3 pyramidal layer (441), CA3 stratum lucidum (158), and CA3 stratum radiatum (289). Reln expression 3.2 — elevated above most DG clusters but substantially below HPF CR clusters. Defining markers: Ntn5, Prox1, Dio3, Ndst4; Prox1 is a granule cell marker, placing this firmly in the DG lineage. This appears to be a DG mossy cell or granule cell subtype, not a Cajal-Retzius cell. The elevated Reln in DG Glut_1 may reflect the minor Reln+ mossy cell population noted in the classical node for dg_mossy_cell, not Cajal-Retzius identity.

Defining markers: Dcn, Prox1, Gcnt1 — Prox1 and Dcn together suggest a granule cell or mossy cell rather than CR identity. Cartpt and Penk neuropeptides are inconsistent with CR cells. 1.name: 0135 HPF CR Glut_1
1.rationale: Supertype directly labeled 'HPF CR' (hippocampal formation Cajal-Retzius). Anatomy is the most focused hippocampal match: Dentate gyrus molecular layer (647 cells; DG OML) and Field CA1 stratum lacunosum-moleculare (140 cells) — matching both expected soma locations of hpc_cajal_retzius_cell precisely. Defining markers at supertype level: Trp73 (p73), Cd274. Trp73 is the canonical transcription factor for Cajal-Retzius cells, consistently cited as a defining CR marker. Cluster-level data confirm very high Reln mean expression (~12.4 across its member clusters CLUS_0497 and CLUS_0500). The 'HPF CR' label plus the dual soma match (CA1 SLM + DG OML) plus Trp73 expression together constitute the highest-confidence match at the supertype level. Caveat: SUPT_0135 contains three clusters (0497, 0499, 0500) of which 0497 is the primary hippocampal cluster and 0499/0500 are olfactory/piriform-predominant — the supertype spans pan-cortical CR cells, with the hippocampal subpopulation concentrated in CLUS_0497.

DG molecular layer representation (441 cells) is compatible with DG OML soma location of CR cells; however, the dominant locations are DG polymorph and CA3 pyramidal — inconsistent with CR identity. The Prox1-expressing member clusters confirm granule/mossy cell identity. This supertype likely includes the Reln+ mossy cell population described in the dg_mossy_cell node, not Cajal-Retzius cells.

non_candidates_summary: Of 30 rank-0 candidates, only 3 (CLUS_0497, CLUS_0500, CLUS_0499 — all HPF CR Glut_1) carry any CR relevance based on Reln expression (mean 12.4, 12.5, 11.9 respectively), Trp73 TF expression, and the 'HPF CR' label. CLUS_0497 is the primary hippocampal match (anatomy: DG molecular layer 640 + CA1 SLM 139 cells). CLUS_0500 and CLUS_0499 represent olfactory/piriform CR-like populations in the same supertype. All other 27 rank-0 candidates lack Reln elevation and have anatomical locations in CA3, DG granule layer, parahippocampal cortex, or distant brain regions (hypothalamus, thalamus, midbrain, cerebellum). Of 20 rank-1 candidates, only SUPT_0135 (HPF CR Glut_1) is a genuine match — it is the parent supertype of CLUS_0497 and captures the same CA1 SLM + DG OML anatomy. Two supertypes (SUPT_0570 VMH and SUPT_0717 midbrain) carry Reln in their defining markers but are disqualified by distant anatomy (hypothalamus and midbrain respectively). The DB scoring function assigned score 4 to 11 supertypes and score 3 to 6 more, largely due to the erroneous UBERON:0005403 → MBA:493 (Striatum) mapping and general glutamatergic NT matching — these scores are uninformative for distinguishing CR cells from the large field of hippocampal glutamatergic neurons.
